chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Do not wear a garment with buttons while you are in the state of ihram, unless you turn it upside down; nor a garment worn like a tunic, nor trousers, unless you do not have an izar; nor khuffayn, unless you have no sandals.

key_terms.إِزَارٌ: a lower wrap garment worn in ihram
key_terms.تَدَرَّعُهُ: wearing it in the manner of a tunic or shirt
key_terms.ثَوْبًا: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: What clothing is forbidden to wear during ihram according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings about what a person in the state of ihram may and may not wear. It outlines prohibited stitched or fitted clothing and mentions limited exceptions when necessary items are unavailable.
